newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Chung Won fails to settle debts.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Chung Won fails to settle debts.

text.p: South Korea's Chung Won Corp was unable to settle promissory notes called in on Monday and now facing a final deadline by the end of Tuesday, officials at the company and its prime creditor bank said.
A Chung Won official, who declined to be identified, put the amount of notes at between 500 million and 600 million won.
An official at the creditor bank, the Commercial Bank of Korea, confirmed Chung Won was facing a final deadline on Tuesday but declined to give more details.
The Korea Stock Exchange suspended trading in Chung Won shares, citing rumours that had been circulating before the company official provided some details.
Chung Won fell 550 won to its daily limit of 6,330 shortly before trading was suspended.
